ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
en: (1) The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].[1577]
enNotes: [1577]- This was a sign given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) when the Quraysh challenged him to show them a miracle.
tr: Iqtarabatis-sāʿatu wanshaqqal-qamar

ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
en: (2) And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."[1578]
tr: Waʾiy yaraw āyatay yuʿriḍū wayaqūlū siḥrum mustamirr

ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
en: (3) And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
tr: Wakadhdhabū wattabaʿū ahwāʾahum wakullu amrim mustaqirr

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
en: (4) And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
tr: Walaqad jāʾahum minal-ambāʾi mā fīhi muzdajar

ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
en: (5) Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
tr: Ḥikmatum bālighatun famā tughnin-nudhur

ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
en: (6) So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller[1579] calls to something forbidding,
enNotes: [1579]- Said to be an angel announcing the account and judgement.
tr: Fatawalla ʿanhum, yawma yadʿud-dāʿi ilā shayʾin nukur

ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
en: (7) Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
tr: Khushshaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna minal-ajdāthi kaʾannahum jarādum muntashir

ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
en: (8) Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
tr: Muhṭiʿīna ilad-dāʿ, yaqūlul-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasir

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
en: (9) The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
tr: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhdhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnuw wazdujir

ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
en: (10) So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
tr: Fadaʿā rabbahū annī maghlūbun fantaṣir

ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
en: (11) Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
tr: Fafataḥnā abwābas-samāʾi bimāʾim munhamir

ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
en: (12) And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
tr: Wafajjarnal-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqal-māʾu ʿalā amrin qad qudir

ar: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
en: (13) And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
tr: Waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti alwāḥiw wadusur

ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
en: (14) Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
tr: Tajrī biʾaʿyuninā, jazāʾal liman kāna kufir

ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: (15) And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqat taraknāhā āyatan fahal mim muddakir

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: (16) And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.[1580]
enNotes: [1580]- To those after them, who were expected to derive a lesson from previous occurrences.
tr: Fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: (17) And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad yassarnal-qurʾāna lidh-dhikri fahal mim muddakir

ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: (18) ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr: Kadhdhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
en: (19) Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
tr: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsim mustamirr

ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
en: (20) Extracting the people[1581] as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
tr: Tanziʿun-nāsa kaʾannahum aʿjāzu nakhlim munqaʿir

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: (21) And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr: Fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: (22) And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad yassarnal-qurʾāna lidh-dhikri fahal mim muddakir

ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: (23) Thamūd denied the warning.
tr: Kadhdhabat thamūdu bin-nudhur

ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
en: (24) And said, "Is it one human being[1582] among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
tr: Faqālū abasharam minnā wāḥidan nattabiʿuhū innā idhal lafī ḍalāliw wasuʿur

ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
en: (25) Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
tr: Aʾulqiyadh-dhikru ʿalayhi mim bayninā bal huwa kadhdhābun ashir

ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
en: (26) They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
tr: Sayaʿlamūna ghadam manil-kadhdhābul-ashir

ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
en: (27) Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.[1583]
enNotes: [1583]- This and the following verse are an address to Ṣāliḥ (upon him be peace).
tr: Innā mursilun-nāqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum waṣṭabir

ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
en: (28) And inform them that the water is shared between them,[1584] each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
enNotes: [1584]- i.e., between the tribe of Thamūd and the she-camel - a day for each to drink.
tr: Wanabbiʾhum annal-māʾa qismatum baynahum, kullu shirbim muḥtaḍar

ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
en: (29) But they called their companion,[1585] and he dared[1586] and hamstrung [her].
enNotes:
[1585]- i.e., the worst and most despicable among them.
[1586]- Or "he took," referring to his sword or to the she-camel.
tr: Fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqar

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: (30) And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr: Fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
en: (31) Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
tr: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥataw wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmil-muḥtaẓir

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: (32) And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad yassarnal-qurʾāna lidh-dhikri fahal mim muddakir

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: (33) The people of Lot denied the warning.
tr: Kadhdhabat qawmu lūṭim bin-nudhur

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
en: (34) Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
tr: Innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭ, najjaynāhum bisaḥar

ar: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
en: (35) As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
tr: Niʿmatam min ʿindinā, kadhālika najzī man shakar

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: (36) And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
tr: Walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bin-nudhur

ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: (37) And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
tr: Walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihī faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhur

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
en: (38) And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
tr: Walaqad ṣabbaḥahum bukratan ʿadhābum mustaqirr

ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: (39) So taste My punishment and warning.
tr: Fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhur

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: (40) And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad yassarnal-qurʾāna lidh-dhikri fahal mim muddakir

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
en: (41) And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
tr: Walaqad jāʾa āla firʿawnan-nudhur

ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
en: (42) They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
tr: Kadhdhabū biʾāyātinā kullihā faʾakhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzim muqtadir

ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
en: (43) Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
tr: Akuffārukum khayrum min ulāʾikum am lakum barāʾatun fiz-zubur

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
en: (44) Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
tr: Am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿum muntaṣir

ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
en: (45) [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].[1587]
enNotes: [1587]- This foretold event took place on the day of Badr.
tr: Sayuhzamul-jamʿu wayuwallūnad-dubur

ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
en: (46) But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
tr: Balis-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum was-sāʿatu adhā waʾamarr

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
en: (47) Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.[1588].
tr: Innal-mujrimīna fī ḍalāliw wasuʿur

ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
en: (48) The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."[1589]
enNotes: [1589]- One of the proper names of Hell.
tr: Yawma yusḥabūna fin-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim, dhūqū massa saqar

ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
en: (49) Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
tr: Innā kulla shayʾin khalaqnāhu biqadar

ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
en: (50) And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
tr: Wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥim bil-baṣar

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: (51) And We have already destroyed your kinds,[1590] so is there any who will remember?
enNotes: [1590]- i.e., those similar to you in attitude and behavior when they rejected Allāh's messengers.
tr: Walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal mim muddakir

ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
en: (52) And everything they did is in written records.
tr: Wakullu shayʾin faʿalūhu fiz-zubur

ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
en: (53) And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
tr: Wakullu ṣaghīriw wakabīrim mustaṭar

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
en: (54) Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
tr: Innal-muttaqīna fī jannātiw wanahar

ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
en: (55) In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.[1591]
enNotes: [1591]- Who accomplishes whatever He wills whenever He wills.
tr: Fī maqʿadi ṣidqin ʿinda malīkim muqtadir
